Unit case volume +2%. Price/mix includes intense-inflation markets (not quantified in this release).

Company: 'approximately 5 points were driven by pricing from markets experiencing intense inflation' (Argentina etc.) -> ex-hyperinflation organic ~7%. Concentrate +2% (qual had 1%); unit case volume +1%.
Unit case volume even (0%). Net operating revenues $47,941m.

latest_interim.note: YTD: organic +8%, price/mix +1%, concentrate sales +6%, unit case volume +4%, FX +2, acq/div -1, reported +9%. Q3-26: organic 7% (price/mix 1%, concentrate 7% = 2pts ahead of unit cases due to shipment timing; unit cases +5%). Q1-26 had six extra days vs Q1-25 (inflates YTD concentrate). FY26 organic guidance raised to 'at least 5%' (Feb-26: 4-5%).

geography.largest_country: United States (INFERENCE: dominant part of North America segment)
geography.note: Net operating revenues by operating segment ($m, total 47,941 after corporate 144 and eliminations -1,009): North America 19,586 (40.9%), EMEA 11,513 (24.0%), Latin America 6,334 (13.2%), Asia Pacific 5,638 (11.8%), Bottling Investments 5,735 (12.0%; largely EM bottlers incl. CCBA/India). Segment basis, not country; Europe-only, UK and China not disclosed in release. CCBA sale pending (expected H2-2026) reduces Bottling Investments.

claim_checks.claim: IRS transfer-pricing case: adverse appeal decision >$10bn is a thesis breaker
claim_checks.finding: Tax Court (2020, supplemental later) ruled for the IRS on 2007-09 years; KO appealed to the 11th Circuit, oral argument ~late June 2026, no decision reported as of the June 2026 article; total exposure ~$20bn, KO paid ~$6bn in 2024, up to ~$14bn more if it loses (secondary source). FY25 and Q3-26 releases: tax-rate guidance 'does not include the impact of ongoing tax litigation with the U.S. Internal Revenue Service, if the company were not to prevail' - i.e. still pending at 2026-10. Decision status after June 2026 not verified.

claim_checks.claim: Organic history 2021-2024 (16/16/12/12) with price-led growth inflated by hyperinflation
claim_checks.finding: Organic 16/16/12/12% confirmed; minor split corrections: 2021 concentrate 9% (not 10%), 2024 concentrate 2% (not 1%). 2024: ~5pts of organic from intense-inflation markets. 2025 organic 5% (price/mix 4, concentrate 1; unit cases flat).
YTD-26 price/mix only +1% vs concentrate +6% / unit cases +4% - a sharp shift from price-led 2022-25 (partly extra selling days and lapping Argentina pricing; INFERENCE).
